stages.name: Refine requirements
stages.prompt: Refine the business requirements from {{sources}}. Preserve identifiers, identify gaps and assumptions, and produce reviewable requirements.

stages.name: Functional design
stages.prompt: Draft the functional design from the requirements in {{prev}}, tracing design decisions back to requirements.

stages.name: Technical design
stages.prompt: Draft the technical design from the functional design in {{prev}}, retaining traceability.

stages.name: Stories
stages.prompt: Write implementable stories and acceptance criteria from the technical design in {{prev}}, retaining traceability.

gateCheck.prompt: Check traceability between {{prev}} and {{current}}. Report gaps and findings only; do not change any files.
